notes.title: Update Notes for v1.0.3
notes.content:
Fixes and Changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where contracts cannot be used in battle if it is the first item after the game is reloaded.
[*] Lighting and shadow optimization in some areas.
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where contracts cannot be used in battle if it is the first item after the game is reloaded.

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.0.2
notes.content:
Fixes and Changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you would use two items instead of one in battle.
[*] Text noises during dialogue has been removed.
[*] Dialogue sped up from 50 letters per second to 200 letters per second.
[*] Default controller settings changed to default xbox controller settings.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed a bug where you would use two items instead of one in battle.

tags.balance_change: [*] Dialogue sped up from 50 letters per second to 200 letters per second.
